Offline Voice distribution

Vosk API and vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15: Alpha Cephei, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api
https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models

vosk-browser 0.0.8: C. Coreilly and contributors, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser

This distribution modifies model.conf endpoint rules 2/3/4 to 0.25/0.35/0.5
seconds and repackages the original model deterministically under model/.
It extracts the original Gr.fst symbol table into vocabulary.json.
Source archive and generated artifact checksums are pinned in model-manifest.json.

The browser engine includes third-party implementations distributed by
vosk-browser; their notices are retained in the bundled engine source, including
Microsoft TypeScript helpers, zstddec and the Kaldi/Vosk WASM runtime.
